result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of designated pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The presence of parked vehicles on both sides creates potential sightline issues for pedestrians attempting to cross the unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or signage indicating where pedestrians should cross the street.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curbs create 'blind spots' where pedestrians, particularly children, may be hidden from drivers' view.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While traffic volume appears low, the wide, unmarked pavement and lack of traffic calming measures create an environment where pedestrians must negotiate space with vehicles without designated protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no designated or prioritized space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions creates a significant barrier for individuals with mobility aids, strollers, or carts.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the stop sign

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The street features sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices at the visible intersection. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars near corners create potential sightline issues and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

result.summary: This residential street features narrow sidewalks and row housing but lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible, leaving pedestrians exposed when crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the sidewalk inaccessible for users with mobility devices at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement in the roadway can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle handling.
